headline:
جزيرة دبي داخل Fortnite
تُطلق عالميًا في 11 نوفمبر
label: رسمي

angle.hook: Ten Dubai landmarks become a Fortnite island that goes live worldwide on 11 November
angle.why_now: Launch is in two days; the wider press has barely covered it and Gulf readers can show up at the launch event
angle.what_it_means_here: A Dubai-made UEFN island backed by DMCC Gaming Centre and tied to the Dubai Program for Gaming 2033; island code, platforms and price not announced, independent of Epic
angle.payoff: what is not yet known, and that Epic neither sponsors nor runs it

searched: DMCC press page (1920x1080 key art, the only image)
lowres_ok.result: only a 1920x1080 still exists; 9:16 crop is 1.78x, under the 2x cap

note: Showcase layout (CLAUDE.md 8 Nov point 5): the only official image (DMCC key art, 1920x1080) is a still, so a picture track was composed on the container (live/2026-11-09/dubai-fortnite-showcase.mp4: ground #141332, azure rules, the art in a 1080x608 window at y 680 with eleven slow push-ins and pans at 1.0 to 1.8x of source pixels, no upscaling past 1:1). Headline in the top band for the whole Reel, story lines and credit in the bottom band. Sound: our bed, no footage with sound exists. v2 (lines over the art) was rejected: lines unreadable on the pale sky.
